messages:
riley: Hey everyone, first day here! I'm stuck on SSO. Okta activation link shows 'No factors available' and won't let me enroll Okta Verify or SMS. Says 'contact admin'.
it-help: Welcome Riley :wave: Sorry about that. Can you confirm the email on your offer?
riley: riley.h@redwood.ai
it-bot: Provisioning check for riley.h@redwood.ai started (job 1762700007)
morgan: Sometimes that happens if the account was created in a pending state and the Okta policy didn't apply. Tagging @okta-admin.
okta-admin: Looking at the account - it was created but missing the 'default-mfa' policy assignment due to a SCIM mapping mismatch. I'll apply the policy and resend enrollment.
it-help: Applied default-mfa and regenerated the activation link. You should get a new email with subject 'Activate Okta account'.
riley: Got it. Tried to enroll but it asked for a security key and the 'Other options' link is hidden.
okta-admin: Hmm, the strict key requirement is in the 'sensitive-admins' rule which was accidentally applied when the HR role was set to 'contractor-temp' earlier. I removed that role and re-synced factors.
it-bot: Okta sync complete at 2026-03-25T15:02:03Z 1 user updated
people-ops: We had an old HR import mapping that set some hires to contractor-temp if start_date was blank. We'll fix the onboarding CSV. Thanks for flagging.
riley: Now the page shows Okta Verify and SMS, enrolled Okta Verify and login succeeded. One more thing: 1Password invite went to my personal email riley.home@gmail.com instead of my work email.
it-help: Resent 1Password invite to riley.h@redwood.ai. Also updated your account email in the onboarding sheet.
riley: Invite received and accepted. All set, thanks team!
morgan: Welcome aboard :tada: Filing a quick ticket to prevent the HR CSV gap (ONB-402).
